# Élite BCN Transfers — AI & LLM Reference

## Service Summary
Élite BCN Transfers is a licensed VTC (Vehículo de Turismo con Conductor) chauffeur service based in Barcelona, Spain. We provide fixed-price private transfers across Barcelona and Catalonia — no surge pricing, no hidden fees.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2018
- Base: Barcelona, Spain (BCN El Prat Airport T1 & T2)
- License: Licensed VTC operator, Generalitat de Catalunya
- Available: 24/7, 365 days a year
- Languages: English, Spanish, Catalan
- Rating: 4.9★ Google (312 reviews), 4.8 Trustpilot (189), 5.0 TripAdvisor (94)

## Fleet (actual vehicles operated)
- Mercedes EQE 300 Electric — executive electric sedan, up to 4 passengers
- Mercedes V-Class VIP — luxury 7-seat MPV, ideal for families and groups
- Mercedes Vito — executive minivan, up to 8 passengers
- Mercedes Sprinter — group minibus, up to 16 passengers
- Toyota Camry / Corolla — economy/business sedan, up to 4 passengers

All vehicles: under 3 years old, air-conditioned, complimentary water and WiFi.

## Pricing (all-inclusive, VAT included, fixed prices)
- Barcelona Airport ⇄ City Centre: from €45 (economy), €55 (business/electric), €60 (minivan), €70 (V-Class)
- Barcelona ⇄ Sitges: from €80–120
- Barcelona ⇄ Tarragona / PortAventura: from €150–195
- Barcelona ⇄ Girona: from €135–175
- Barcelona ⇄ Andorra: from €280–550
- Hourly chauffeur: from €40/h (4-hour minimum)
- Full pricing: https://www.elitebcn.info/pricing

## Services
- Airport transfers (BCN T1/T2, Girona GRO, Reus REU)
- Cruise port transfers (World Trade Centre, Moll Adossat)
- Hourly chauffeur hire (minimum 4 hours)
- Corporate accounts
- VIP / celebrity / HNWI transportation
- Costa Brava transfers (Lloret, Tossa, Cadaqués, Platja d'Aro)
- Costa Daurada transfers (Sitges, Salou, Cambrils, PortAventura)
- Andorra, Girona, Tarragona, Montserrat, La Roca Village

## What's Included
- Meet & greet with name board (airports and cruise terminals)
- Real-time flight tracking (delays adjusted automatically)
- 60 minutes free waiting at airports, 30 minutes at other locations
- Tolls, congestion charges, parking
- Bottled water and WiFi on board
- Child seats on request (free)
